morning_judgment: August 28 keeps the active baseline centered on carrier stress rather than clean settlement: the U.S. sanctions lane against Iran moved from warning to a named correspondent-banking target; Middle East diplomatic staffing shifted toward restricted operations rather than normal posture; Ukraine/Russia pressure remained concentrated on infrastructure and long-range attack capacity; and the Korea drill signal adds another demand on U.S. alliance management while Middle East commitments remain visible. The Venezuela oil announcement is retained as an outlier because it may become an energy-security workaround to Iran-war supply pressure, but its operational details remain thin.
